cases.name: the paging loop asks for one page instead of four
the stream interceptor stops counting, so reads read as free
the janitor stops deleting, so the suite is polluted
cases.old: janitor.delete(DOCS, [[key] for key in range(FIRST_KEY, FIRST_KEY + ROWS * 2)])
cases.expect_survivor: this file alone cannot see it. The damage is to other files' tests — five in test_streaming.py, which count rows rather than naming them — so the mutation is caught by the suite and not by this command. Recorded rather than widened because pointing this case at the whole suite would make every mutation here a two-minute run.
